title: Visualising software architecture with the C4 model - Simon Brown, Agile on the Beach 2019
summary: Simon Brown's Agile on the Beach 2019 talk presents the C4 model, a lightweight approach to diagramming software architecture with a shared vocabulary and simple notation.
why: Recommended as the introduction to C4 when people ask how to visualize and communicate software architecture.

quote.text: If C4 is new to you too, I recommend their intro video
